title: Planetary Prediction Engine
teaser: A Google research team presented the experimental Planetary Prediction Engine (Planetary Prediction Engine, PPE) as part of the Google Earth AI initiative. In response to a natural-language request, the system independently runs the entire geospatial data-processing pipeline: finding and cleaning data, creating features, training and evaluating models, and then generating a forecast and report. On various tasks in healthcare, food security, environmental risks, and the socioeconomic sphere, PPE improved accuracy compared with baseline approaches, reducing model development from several weeks of manual work to a few minutes.
